provenance: Independently authored ledger additions exposing existing composition, SVG and escape policy. Literal values and operation order are unchanged; original reference fixtures are not rewritten.

assumption_rows.name: compose_guard
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_guard                  = 4             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.guard_mm — margin subtracted from near bounds during composition

assumption_rows.name: compose_repair_max
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_repair_max             = 16            iterations [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.repair_max — maximum iterations of composition constraint repair

assumption_rows.name: compose_median_passes
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_median_passes          = 8             passes     [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.median_passes — weighted median passes for composition refinement

assumption_rows.name: compose_channel_min_nets
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_channel_min_nets       = 6             nets       [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.channel_min_nets — minimum channel demand that receives a separation constraint

assumption_rows.name: compose_channel_floor
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_channel_floor          = 2             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.channel_floor — minimum reserved channel separation

assumption_rows.name: compose_channel_per_net
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_channel_per_net        = 0.2           mm/net     [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.channel_per_net — additional channel separation per demanded net

assumption_rows.name: compose_hop_weight
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_hop_weight             = 1             weight     [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.hop_weight — flow-hop attraction weight in composition refinement

assumption_rows.name: compose_seed_weight
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME compose_seed_weight            = 0.05          weight     [policy] board_decision_policy.compose.seed_weight — seed-position retention weight in composition refinement

assumption_rows.name: floorplan_svg_origin_x
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME floorplan_svg_origin_x         = 46            px         [policy] board_decision_policy.svg.ox — horizontal drawing origin of the floorplan SVG

assumption_rows.name: floorplan_svg_origin_y
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME floorplan_svg_origin_y         = 64            px         [policy] board_decision_policy.svg.oy — vertical drawing origin of the floorplan SVG

assumption_rows.name: floorplan_svg_scale
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME floorplan_svg_scale            = 6             px/mm      [policy] board_decision_policy.svg.scale — floorplan SVG drawing scale

assumption_rows.name: escape_construct_radius
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME escape_construct_radius        = 1.8           mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.escape.radius — escape corridor construction reach

assumption_rows.name: escape_lattice
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME escape_lattice                 = 0.05          mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.escape.lattice — escape via search lattice spacing

assumption_rows.name: escape_lane_handle
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME escape_lane_handle             = 1             mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.escape.lane_handle — escape lane extent beyond the connector contact row

assumption_rows.name: escape_hole_clearance
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME escape_hole_clearance          = 0.5           mm         [policy] board_decision_policy.escape.hole_hole — minimum hole-to-hole separation in escape search
